role: set of all sorted variables of a strict many-sorted signature
notes: Union of the per-sort variable stocks of def:p02-many-sorted-signature; identified with its image under the fixed injection into the one-sorted variable supply.

role: context: a set of sorted variables
notes: Local role only; Delta has many other roles elsewhere in the book (sets of formulas, diagrams). Declared before use here.

role: contextual sorted assignment and its update
notes: A Delta-assignment sends each variable of the context into the carrier of its sort; total assignments are written s as in def:p02-many-sorted-structure.

role: value of a sorted term under a contextual assignment
notes: Same bracket glyph as the categorical interpretation brackets of Part 10; here a set-theoretic term value. Scopes are disjoint.

role: satisfaction of a sorted formula at a contextual assignment
notes: Requires FV(varphi) within the domain of g; for strict structures and total assignments it is M,s entails varphi of def:p02-many-sorted-structure.

role: names of the four sort-axiom families
notes: Nonemptiness, constant typing, function closure, disjointness; together exactly Ax_sort of def:p02-many-sorted-translation.

role: sort theories for the empty-sort and overlapping-sort reductions
notes: Ax_sort without the nonemptiness family, and Ax_sort without the disjointness family, respectively.

role: context guard: sort atoms for the variables of a context
notes: Guard of the set of all sorted variables is VarGuard_MS of def:p02-ms-variable-guard.

role: coverage axiom for finitely many sorts
notes: One-sorted sentence: every element satisfies some sort predicate; defined only when Sort is finite.

role: restriction of a one-sorted model to its sort predicates
notes: Sorted structure with carriers Q_s^A and restricted interpretations.

role: transport of a sorted structure along sort injections with fill functions
notes: h_s injects the carrier of sort s into the one-sorted domain; j_f gives the value of f at ill-typed inputs.

role: tagged one-sorted structure with junk point and its tagged assignment
notes: Junk point star is the pair (Sort,Sort). The sharp superscript also marks the incidence-translation assignment in thm:p02-sol-incidence-satisfaction; different scope and object.

role: tagged one-sorted structure with defaults from a total assignment
notes: Used for the coverage variant; no junk point.

role: plain-union one-sorted structure with junk point
notes: Domain is the union U of the carriers together with U itself as junk point.

role: empty-sort consequence in a context and with total assignments
notes: Quantifies over E-structures (disjoint carriers, possibly empty).
Quantifies over cup-structures (nonempty carriers, possibly overlapping) and total assignments; language includes cross-sort equality.
M_0 empties exactly the sorts without variable-free terms; A_0 is the covering one-sorted model on the set of sorts.
